messages:
zoe: dropping a tiny thread about a microflow for copying/opening traces from compact rows. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/compact-trace-microflow
mica: quick read: love the intent. main worry is too many clicks for support teams who just want a permalink. can we make the default copy action offer a small context menu (id vs link) without a full modal?
rahul: micro-menu sounds good. default Enter on the copy control should copy the id (fast path). a small chevron opens menu with: Copy id, Copy link (24h), Copy link (permanent - admins only).
aisha: accessibility: menu must be keyboard operable. arrow keys to move, Enter to select, Esc to close. each menu item needs aria-label and role=menuitem. on selection announce via role=status: "Trace link copied" etc.
zoe: UX detail: show a transient inline pill "Link copied" next to the control for 1.4s. no toasts for this dense view. SRs still get aria-live text.
mica: also surface a tiny lock icon for permanent links so users know about auth. hover text: "requires sign-in". ensure the icon has aria-hidden and the hover description is the accessible label for the menu item.
rahul: export flow: rename "Export trace" to "Download trace (JSON)" and add two radio options in the modal: Full trace and Error-centric. add a small size estimate for each when selected so users understand payload.
aisha: checkbox "Attach request logs" should default off and show estimated delta in size. announce selection changes to SRs if needed.
zoe: stack preview behavior: current truncation cuts inside function names. prefer token-aware truncation that preserves identifiers and shows file:line when space limited. also keep the snippet selectable (monospace) so users can copy lines.
mica: visual polish: use a fade gradient instead of hard ellipsis so users understand the text is selectable and clipped. ensure contrast still passes AA for the fade overlay when used.
rahul: keyboard order: row link -> micro-id -> copy -> open -> overflow. on mobile collapse the visible open button and move into the expanded sheet. document the breakpoint behavior.
aisha: shortcuts: propose Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C to copy link when focus on the id, and Cmd/Ctrl+O to open trace. include the shortcut text in tooltips and ensure tooltips are accessible via aria-describedby.
zoe: analytics: fire events copy_id, copy_link, download_initiated with props: trace_id, user_role, option_selected. helps measure which affordances are used.
ux-bot: run the compact-row a11y checklist: keyboard nav, screen-reader readthrough, focus order, color contrast, tooltip accessibility, reduced-motion compliance: https://internal.redwood/ux/checklists/compact-trace-row
mica: thanks all 60a i'll update frames with micro-menu, lock icon, modal copy changes, stack truncation rules, and the a11y notes. will ping when pushed for a quick sign-off.
